craft_notes: Sthāyin: svādhyāya-vīra of study-and-making — hermetic couplets, hyphen-pressure; music in pack + terminal words; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (owner verdict required). Six-one abiding; past-systems-end; unsayable-goal triple close. Rejected: (a) expanding six → killed: six stays counted. (b) goal→end → killed: goal keeps direction. Read aloud: ONE-ness OF-six-ROADS … UN-say-A-ble, su-PREME, the-GOAL.

lines: One-ness of six roads — where Bhairavī stands —
past all systems' end — unsayable, supreme, the goal.
l4.sanskrit_cite: aikadhyam adhvanāṃ ṣa.ṅnāṃ yatra sā bhairavī sthitiḥ | paryante sarvatantrāṇām avācyā paramā gatiḥ
